sloka: तमसा संवृतं सर्वमासीद्भीमतरं महत्।अस्तं गते सहस्रांशौ संवृतं तमसेव हि ।। ६.९०.३५ ।।
transliteration: tamasā saṁvṛtaṁ sarvamāsīdbhīmataraṁ mahat।astaṁ gate sahasrāṁśau saṁvṛtaṁ tamaseva hi ।। 6.90.35 ।।

translations.english: Many hundreds of pointed arrows falling in all directions and intermediate points spread all over.
